description: A Roman soldier in a crested helmet and scale armour and red-trimmed cloak grips a heavy dark patterned curtain in a marble palace hall. Behind it, an older, thin, grey-haired man in a cream tunic cowers against a wall with a wide-eyed frightened look and one hand raised. A second helmeted soldier stands in the background shadows, and the floor is a patterned mosaic. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no visible text.
